name: 简约木色格子速装储物架款
description: 免工具卡扣速装格子储物架，层高可调分区收纳，多层数款型适配客厅书房

styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft misty blue gradient wall with floating white rounded card panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused daylight, gentle upper-left key, soft natural shadows, airy calm mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: light wood floor and matte white card surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short headlines in #2D2D2D with small light-grey english sublabels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons inside soft circular grey badges
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle at consistent scale, product always clean, centered, fully grounded with contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean nordic home-furniture ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue background #B9CFD9, pure white card panels #FFFFFF, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and warm light-wood accent #D9BE97; cool neutral tone warmed by wood accents; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines only; white rounded rectangular label pills and thin-line circular badge icons; bright soft diffused daylight with soft natural shadows; stable centered product presentation at consistent scale with natural even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索第一眼呈现整体轮廓与木白配色，赢取点击并符合平台白底规范
shots.camera: centered front 3/4 view at eye level, full product visible top to bottom of legs
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: natural even margins on all four sides, no reserved copy space
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered front 3/4 view at eye level, full storage shelf visible from top panel to the bottom of legs, slight 3/4 angle showing the front facade and one side panel. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key light with gentle fill, soft contact shadow grounding the unit on the floor. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. Product occupies 60-70% of frame with natural even margins on all four sides. Crisp clean silhouette, 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 一秒传达分区收纳与可调层高的核心利益，承接首屏
shots.camera: front 3/4 medium shot, product filling the lower 55% of frame
shots.lighting: bright soft diffused daylight from upper left, soft natural shadow
shots.props: a few small vases inside compartments, none blocking the front
shots.textZone: upper 40% headline in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 plus a row of three white rounded pill labels 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero on a misty blue #B9CFD9 gradient wall. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Product shown at a front 3/4 medium shot filling the lower 55% of the frame, compartments facing the viewer. Bright soft diffused daylight from upper left, soft natural shadow. The upper 40% carries the message: large headline in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 and three white rounded pill labels in a row reading 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」. Product occupies 50-60% of frame. Negative: no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra decorative elements, no cut-off product, no garbled text.

shots.intent: 放大杂物散乱的生活痛点，右侧给出分区收纳的解决画面
shots.camera: documentary slightly handheld split screen, identical camera height and crop on both sides
shots.lighting: left panel heavier directional light, right panel brighter even diffused light
shots.background: relatable real home corner, left cluttered floor #D8D3CC tones, right tidy corner with light wood floor #C9B08C
shots.props: left: scattered books, boxes and sundries; right: items neatly divided inside {product}
shots.textZone: short caption label on each side in #2D2D2D: left 「{callout_1}」, right 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: a cluttered home corner with scattered books, boxes and sundries on the floor, documentary slightly handheld framing, heavier directional light. Right panel: the same corner angle with {product} neatly dividing and storing the items, brighter even light. Identical camera height and crop on both sides for a fair before-and-after read. Product occupies 40-50% within its panel. Short caption labels on each side in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 left and 「{callout_2}」 right, each caption on a clean slim strip. Negative: no exaggerated fake mess beyond a believable cluttered home, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text, no garbled text, no distorted room geometry.

shots.intent: 微距证明板材贴面与封边工艺，打消材质疑虑
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on panel edge and surface finish, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing smooth laminated surface and fine edge banding, controlled highlight
shots.background: neutral light-grey #F2F3F5 softly out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: one small annotation label in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 near the detail
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tight zoom on the panel edge and surface finish, shallow depth of field with the foreground edge sharp, raking side light from the right revealing the smooth laminated surface and fine edge banding. Neutral light-grey #F2F3F5 background softly out of focus. Detail occupies 55-60% of frame with minimal surrounding space so the texture reads full-bleed. One small annotation label in #2D2D2D reading 「{callout_1}」 near the detail. Negative: no blurry subject, no fabricated material texture, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated panels in background.

shots.lighting: soft diffused light, gentle floor shadow
shots.background: misty blue #B9CFD9 header band, white rounded card #FFFFFF containing the product
shots.whitespace: about 20% margins around the white card panel
shots.textZone: headline in #2D2D2D top right reading 「{callout_1}」 with a short subline; slim dotted dimension callout with label 「{callout_2}」 marking the clearance height
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic detail screen on misty blue #B9CFD9. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Headline in #2D2D2D top right reading 「{callout_1}」 with a short subline. shots.props: small potted plant beside the unit, a few books and one vase inside compartments, max 3 prop groups, none covering the product front

Eye-level front 3/4 view, full product visible and anchoring the composition. Natural window daylight from the left at about 5500K, soft natural shadows falling right. shots.intent: 并排展示多层数多宽度款型，让买家快速锁定自己的规格

shots.lighting: even soft diffused studio light, no drift between cards

Headline top right reading 「{callout_5}」. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no color drift between cards, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cut-off products.

shots.intent: 结构化尺寸标注回答买多大放得下的疑问

shots.lighting: even flat readable light, no dramatic shadow
shots.textZone: slim #2D2D2D dimension lines with labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 including units; compact spec block in the upper third with two short rows 「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen on pale grey-blue #E4EAEE. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Product shown from a high 45-degree angle looking down, filling the lower two thirds, with slim #2D2D2D dimension callout lines marking width, depth, height and inner compartment size, labels reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 with units. In the upper third a compact spec block with two short rows reading 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」. Even flat readable lighting, clean structured layout. Product occupies 65-75%. shots.intent: 用统一图标语言汇总工艺与服务承诺，降低决策风险
shots.camera: straight-on symmetric infographic layout, small centered product thumbnail at bottom
shots.background: white #FFFFFF page with light grey #F5F6F8 rounded card
shots.textZone: six circular thin-line icon badges in two rows with short labels in #2D2D2D reading 「{selling_point_1}」 to 「{selling_point_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on symmetric layout: a light grey #F5F6F8 rounded card fills the middle of the frame, above its lower edge a small centered product thumbnail, and inside it six circular thin-line icon badges in two rows, each badge with a short label in #2D2D2D reading 「{selling_point_1}」 to 「{selling_point_6}」. Even high-key soft light, the card and thumbnail together occupy 40-50% of frame with balanced panel margins. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data, no fake logos, no dense certificates, no watermark, no garbled text, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 以封边与木纹工艺特写并置产品收尾，用可看到的做工细节传递品质
shots.camera: straight-on composition, full product at left, tight macro inset of edge banding and wood grain at right
shots.lighting: even soft high-key light with a raking accent on the detail panel
shots.textZone: headline in #2D2D2D top right reading 「{callout_1}」 with a short subline 「{callout_2}」; small caption under the macro inset reading 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust closing screen on pale grey #E9EBED. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on composition: {product} at left occupying 50-60% shown in a clean front 3/4 view, at right a tight macro inset panel revealing the fine edge banding, smooth laminate surface and warm wood grain texture of the same unit, lit with a raking accent so the craftsmanship is visible. Headline in #2D2D2D top right reading 「{callout_1}」 with a short subline 「{callout_2}」, and a small caption in #2D2D2D under the macro inset reading 「{callout_3}」. Even soft high-key light. Negative: do NOT generate dense certificate text, serial numbers or invented certification names, no fake logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no extra decorative elements, no fabricated material texture.

provenance.notes: 10 张 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。源文件夹名「家装家具家用品」仅参考：按图判断主体为板木结合格子储物架（书架式格柜），故归入 家具家纺/收纳家具 而非家居日用。已剥离：源页标题与逐字文案、专有工艺表述（改用 {selling_point}/{callout} 槽位）、英文装饰小字、会员促销二维码贴纸、不可验证的资质类元素。收尾镜改为封边与木纹工艺特写，用可看到的做工细节传递品质。与库内 chuwushounaishugui（储物收纳柜）区分：本款为开放式格子格架形态。
